title: A count correction travels forward
hook: The record says ten, the shelf has eight. Which count remains after shipping three?

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Propagate a counted inventory discrepancy through a later transaction.

misconception: A later dispatch automatically fixes an earlier inventory error.
objective: Propagate a counted inventory discrepancy through a later transaction.

claims.text: The physical count is two below the record. Three units are then dispatched. Scaled model; count difference=2; dispatch=3; no receipts.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Record=10, A=5items and B=7items. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["-","x",5]; B=["-","x",3]; x denotes Record. At x=10, A=5, B=7; recall at x=13: B=10. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: Subtract the discrepancy before updating the dispatch. Shipping three from an already incorrect record preserves its two-unit error. A corrected observation needs to travel into the next calculation.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["-","x",5]; B=["-","x",3]; x denotes Record. At x=10, A=5, B=7; recall at x=13: B=10. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. The principle follows from those expressions and stated scenario limits.

claims.text: The physical count is two below the record. Three units are then dispatched. Change only Record to 13. What is B (Recorded) now? Correct: 10items. Use B's stated rule with Record=13: it gives 10items. Subtract the discrepancy before updating the dispatch. Shipping three from an already incorrect record preserves its two-unit error. A corrected observation needs to travel into the next calculation.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["-","x",5]; B=["-","x",3]; x denotes Record. At x=10, A=5, B=7; recall at x=13: B=10. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

recall.question: The physical count is two below the record. Three units are then dispatched. Change only Record to 13. What is B (Recorded) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Record=13: it gives 10items. Subtract the discrepancy before updating the dispatch. Shipping three from an already incorrect record preserves its two-unit error. A corrected observation needs to travel into the next calculation.

safety.assumptions: The physical count is two below the record. Three units are then dispatched.
safety.excluded: No chemical mixtures, medical advice, wiring, safety-device bypass, actual tariffs, financial recommendations, temperature, food-storage or food-safety instructions. All energy powers, durations and tariffs are illustrative.
